title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
About the Opportunity

Opus Spark is hiring a Virtual Executive Assistant on behalf of our client, a mission driven national advocacy nonprofit led by a dynamic founder. You will work directly with the Founder and CEO as her right hand, keeping her days organized, her systems clean, and her projects moving. This is a role for someone who takes real pride in being the most organized person in the room and who loves making an executive's life easier.



The Role

1. Provide day to day executive support to the Founder and CEO, including inbox and calendar management, meeting preparation, and follow ups.

2. Own the organization's CRM: keep contacts, donors, and outreach records accurate, current, and well structured.

3. Make routine website edits and content updates, keeping pages accurate and fresh.

4. Track projects, deadlines, and commitments so nothing slips through the cracks.

5. Handle light administrative projects as they come up, with the judgment to prioritize and flag what matters.



What We Are Looking For

1. Proven experience as an executive assistant or in a similar high trust support role for a founder or senior executive.

2. Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail. This is the heart of the role.

3. Hands on CRM experience and the confidence to learn new systems quickly.

4. Experience working day to day in Slack and Google Workspace.

5. Comfort making website edits and content updates on a modern website platform.

6. Clear, professional written communication and a warm, proactive working style.

7. Reliability working remotely: consistent availability, strong internet, and self direction.



Experience with nonprofits, advocacy organizations, or fast moving founder led teams is a plus, as is

familiarity with social media or basic design tools.



Tools and Technologies

1. Slack for day to day team communication.

2. Google Workspace for
, calendar, documents, and file sharing.

3. CRM: hands on experience with a modern CRM is required. The specific platform is shared during the

interview process. Experience with nonprofit and advocacy CRMs such as EveryAction, NationBuilder, or Salesforce is a plus.

4. Website: routine page and content edits are part of the role, on the platform shared during the interview process.



Engagement Details

1. Part time, with weekly hours and schedule shaped with the client based on the workload.

2. Fully remote.

3. Independent contractor engagement through Opus Spark.

4. For a truly exceptional candidate who is only available full time, the client is open to a conversation.

title: Medical-Legal Virtual Receptionist (REMOTE)
description:
Medical-Legal Virtual Receptionist (REMOTE)



Graduates or students from top universities in the Philippines are HIGHLY encouraged to apply (UP, Ateneo, DLSU, UST, etc.), or experienced Medical VAs.



Pay Rate: $6.00/ hour



Shift: US Pacific Time (PST) — Operating on scheduled California Medical Evaluation days (Weekdays & Occasional Saturdays as needed).



About the Role

We are seeking a highly articulate, organized, and confident Virtual Receptionist to act as a vital remote assistant to our California Doctors on Qualified Medical Evaluator (QME) evaluation days.



In this role, you will be the real-time operational bridge between applicants (patients), doctors, and our core management team. You will handle live day-of communications, track applicant attendance and evaluation status, flag no-shows immediately, and ensure our AI scribing software is actively running, verified for accuracy, and properly filed for every case.



Key Responsibilities

1. Applicant Attendance & Status Tracking:

- Track applicant (patient) check-in times, evaluation progress, and check-out status in real-time across all scheduled appointments.

- Immediately flag and report no-shows, late arrivals, or cancellations to the doctor and admin team according to protocol.

- Maintain accurate live logs of evaluation day activity and patient status updates.



2. Live Evaluation Day Coordination:

- Serve as the doctor’s right-hand assistant on evaluation days—managing patient intake workflows, doctor alerts, and schedule flow.



3. Patient & Doctor Communications:

- Handle professional, friendly, and clear communications with California applicants, law firm representatives, and evaluating physicians via phone, chat, or video call.



4. AI Scribing Management & Filing:

- Ensure AI scribing software is properly initiated and active during doctor-applicant evaluations.

- Verify audio capture clarity and review AI-generated notes for accuracy.

- Make minor formatting adjustments as needed and ensure final transcripts and reports are properly uploaded and filed in our system.



5. Team Collaboration:

- Maintain real-time sync with our US-based ops team to flag missing legal paperwork, schedule adjustments, or immediate doctor requests.



Candidate Requirements (IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ)

1. Native / Near-Native American Accent: Exceptional spoken English skills with a clear, natural American accent (Mandatory & Non-Negotiable).

2. Confidence & Poise: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to maintain composure and authority when interacting with US doctors, law firms, and applicants.

3. Meticulous Organization: Strong multitasker who can track real-time attendance, monitor AI tools, and keep patient records organized under fast-paced conditions.

4. Educational Background: Graduates or students from top Philippine universities (UP, Ateneo, DLSU, UST, etc.) or applicants with strong healthcare/medical VA backgrounds are preferred.



Technical Setup:

1. High-speed, reliable fiber internet.

2. Professional noise-canceling headset (USB with active noise cancellation).

3. Dual-monitor setup preferred* (for simultaneous patient tracking and system management).

4. Backup power source (UPS/generator) and backup internet connection.



How to Apply (IMPORTANT: READ CAREFULLY)

To be considered for this position, you must submit a GOOGLE DRIVE LINK to the following:

1. Updated Resume (PDF format).

2. Short Video Introduction (1–2 minutes max) via Loom or Google Drive link covering:

- A brief introduction about yourself and your educational background.

- Why you are a perfect fit for a fast-paced, real-time Virtual Assistant role supporting US doctors and tracking patient clinic flows.

3. Diploma/TOR.



Note: Please ensure your video is recorded in a quiet environment with your camera turned on.



STRICT APPLICATION NOTICE:



Applications that do not meet all requirements, fail to include a video, or submit a generic/reused video will be automatically disqualified without review. Clear, authentic American English pronunciation is strictly required.

title: Head of Digital Growth: Web Developer + Marketer (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full-time, 40 hrs/week

WAGE: US$1,386 / month ($8/h to start) with bonuses and salary increases based on growth

HOURS: Flexible, with 4 hours' overlap with US Eastern time (Atlanta) on weekdays

BENEFITS: 13th month (prorated first year), paid Philippine regular holidays, PTO, and sick days. We trust you to manage your time — if the work is done and growth is on track, we've got you covered when you need a day off or you're under the weather.



ABOUT US

We're a lactation practice of 16 providers serving families across metro Atlanta. Our IBCLCs (lactation consultants) help new parents through a critical time in early parenthood.



Our care is strong. What we don't have yet is one person who owns everything digital: the website, ads, content, tracking, and the systems that connect them. We're looking for that person.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Most marketing jobs give you one lane. This one covers the whole thing. You'll write the plan, build the pages, launch the ads, set up the tracking, and then show us in plain numbers which posts and campaigns turn into booked consults.



When something should be built rather than bought, you're free to build it. We want a partner who thinks ahead, tells us the truth, and gets things done. We don't want someone who waits for a task list.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Strategy and advice

- Turn our business goals into a 90-day plan with a short list of priorities and clear KPIs

- Send a one-page monthly report: what worked, what didn't, and what's next

- Advise the owner honestly, including when an idea isn't worth doing yet



2. Website and landing pages

- Own the website: design, speed, mobile, accessibility, security, and uptime

- Build landing pages and booking funnels for each service and area we serve

- Work in real code (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) as well as in page builders and CMSs

- Keep patient information safe. Keep tracking pixels off pages where they shouldn't be, and use HIPAA-appropriate forms and tools



3. Tracking and attribution

- Map the full path for every lead: post → click → lead → qualified → booked → revenue

- Set up GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel / Conversions API, UTMs, call tracking, and CRM pipeline stages

- Build a dashboard the owner can read in two minutes



4. Search: Google, Maps, and AI answers

- Local SEO for every area we serve, plus Google Business Profiles, reviews, and citations

- Content that answers the real questions parents ask, with proper structured data (schema)

- Make sure we show up when parents ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or Google's AI Overviews



5. Paid ads

- Plan, launch, and optimize
 and Instagram ads, and Google Ads where they make sense

- Keep testing hooks, formats, and offers. Cut what doesn't work quickly and scale what does



6. Social and content

- Grow our Instagram and
 with steady, useful content

- Turn our providers' expertise into short videos, carousels, and posts

- Edit short-form video from provider footage and design on-brand graphics

- Keep the voice warm, calm, and parent-first



7. Automation and AI

- Use AI to speed up content and operations, with a human checking everything before it reaches a patient



MUST HAVE

- 5+ years of hands-on digital work that spans both web and marketing, with links to things you built yourself

- Able to build and fix websites, not only edit templates

- Have set up conversion tracking end to end and can explain it simply

- Have run
/Instagram ads with real budgets

- Clear written English, and the patience to explain technical things to non-technical people

- Self-directed: you spot the problem, propose the fix, and ship it

- Reliable internet and backup power



NICE TO HAVE

- Healthcare, wellness, or service-business experience, and awareness of HIPAA

- Video editing and graphic design

- React/Next.js, Python, APIs, servers, and hosting

- ClickFunnels, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or a similar CRM

- Local SEO across multiple areas or locations

- An IT or systems background (backups, access control, security)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 30 days: everything is audited, tracking is fixed, and a clear 90-day plan is agreed.

- First 90 days: the attribution dashboard is live, every service has its own landing page, ads and organic content run on a weekly rhythm, the website is faster, and the Google profiles are cleaned up.

- 12 months: the owner knows where every booked consult came from, visibility in search and AI answers keeps rising, and marketing runs on systems rather than heroics.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term, full-time, stable work

- Real ownership and room to build

- A budget for the right tools

- Meaningful work: every booking is a family getting help when they need it most



HOW TO APPLY (we read every application)

 1. Subject line: "Atlanta Growth – [Your Name]"

 2. Make the first word of your message "Latch" so we know you read to the end

 3. Share links to 3 things you built yourself (a website, landing page, dashboard, automation, or video) and describe your role in each

 4. Confirm you can align on $8/hour to start, that you're available full-time (40 hrs/week), and let us know your earliest possible start date



We won't review applications that have no links to real work.

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services
description:
Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services



We are looking for an experienced sales representative to join our team and sell home services to inbound leads.



This is not an entry-level sales position. We are looking for someone who already knows how to speak with homeowners, understand their needs, build trust quickly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.



You will be speaking with customers who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to turn those opportunities into booked and paid jobs.



Responsibilities:

Respond quickly to inbound phone, web, and other leads

Speak with homeowners about their project and understand exactly what they need

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Build trust and confidently guide customers toward purchasing

Handle common objections around price, timing, competitors, and project details

Follow up with leads who do not purchase immediately

Keep accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

Meet sales and conversion targets

Communicate with the operations team when needed to ensure a smooth customer experience



Requirements:

Previous sales experience is required

Strong preference for experience selling home services, construction, HVAC, landscaping, roofing, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, junk removal, materials, or similar services

Proven ability to close inbound leads

Excellent spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and professional working environment

Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools



What We're Looking For:

We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.



A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer, addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to move forward.



Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.

Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following:

Why do you think you would be good at this role?

How to Apply



Send us:

Your resume

Your video introduction

title: YouTube Content Specialist
description:
Skills to Change Institute · Work from home · Basic social media role · Results-based hours



Who I am, and what this is

I’m Robert Gene, founder of the Skills to Change Institute and creator of eutaptics® and FasterEFT™ methods. For more than thirty years, I have used this method to help people address a wide range of long-standing problems, including addictions, relationship difficulties, emotional distress, pain, sleep problems, food and chemical intolerances, money-related patterns, limiting beliefs, and a lot more.



About the Role

I am looking for an experienced YouTube Content Specialist to help transform an established YouTube channel with 2,600+ existing videos into a well-structured, optimized platform that reaches new audiences and generates new customers. The channel focuses on the personal transformation methods eutaptics® and FasterEFT™ and contains a large library of educational and training content.

I'm looking for someone who understands YouTube growth, analytics, content optimization, and video repurposing.



What You'll Do

- Learn the Method: Complete paid training and selected Skills to Change courses to understand the method, terminology, audience, and my communication style.

- Weekly Content Production: Use Robert’s ongoing live calls and Q&As as source material to create 1 strong long-form YouTube video per week from a selected question-and-answer segment, and repurpose it into 2–3 engaging YouTube Shorts 

- Audit & Strategy: Analyze the channel and YouTube Analytics to identify what works, uncover high-potential content, and prioritize which videos to optimize first.

- Optimize Existing Content: Improve titles, descriptions, thumbnails, chapters, playlists, end screens, internal linking, and calls to action based on search intent and performance data.

- Create Shorts & Reels: Find strong hooks and moments within existing long-form videos and turn them into engaging short-form content, ideally using OpusClip. Content may also be repurposed for Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Visual Design: Create effective YouTube thumbnails and simple on-brand graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Track & Improve: Monitor CTR, retention, watch time, search performance, traffic sources, and subscriber growth, and continuously improve the strategy based on results.

- Drive Growth & Conversion: Help turn viewers into followers and customers by creating effective content journeys: Short → Long-form Video → Related Content → Website / Training / Program.



Who I'm Looking For

Someone who is experienced, organized, reliable, accountable, and able to work independently. You should be genuinely curious about personal development and human behavior and willing to understand the work behind the content. I am looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration.



Skills You Need

Proven experience growing or optimizing YouTube channels, with examples or measurable results.

Strong understanding of YouTube Analytics, SEO, search intent, CTR, retention, and watch time.

Experience with long-form content and creating engaging Shorts/Reels.

Solid video editing skills.

Ability to create effective thumbnails using Canva or similar tools.

Strong written English.

Strong analytical and organizational skills.

Comfortable using AI tools to work efficiently without replacing strategic thinking and creativity.



Nice to Have

Experience in coaching, wellness, personal development, or related fields

Experience with OpusClip, CapCut, or similar video editing tools



What you get

A long-term remote job with the opportunity to raise tied to results.

A paid onboarding and training period.

Payment twice a month, on the 1st and the 16th.

The opportunity to learn a method that may also be personally valuable to you and that you can use on yourself and the people you love for the rest of your life.



How we work

We agree on priorities, deadlines, and expected deliverables in advance. You will have flexibility in when you complete the work, but reliability, communication, and meeting agreed deadlines are essential.



You will track your working time so that every agreed hour is recorded and paid. At the end of each workday, you will submit a short update covering:

What you worked on

What you completed

What you learned

Any questions or obstacles

What you will work on next



This reporting system is designed to keep the team coordinated and identify problems early. It is not intended as micromanagement.



You should be available for an agreed amount of working-time overlap with European Central Time (10:00 AM to 2:00 PM CET daily). No graveyard shift is required.



Attendance at our weekly team meeting is required (Tuesdays, 11:00 AM CET, 1 hour). This is where we review priorities, share feedback, and keep the work moving. 



How to apply

Start your application with the word PEACE so we know you have read the complete job post. 

Please include:

- A short introduction describing your copywriting and marketing experience and why this particular role interests you (CV+motivation letter).

- Share links to YouTube accounts you have managed, grown, or contributed to. 

- Include 2-3 examples of short clips, reels, or posts you personally created. 

- List the tools and platforms you currently use for video editing, design, and scheduling (e.g., OpusClip, Canva, Metricool, etc.). 

- Please include your expected hourly rate and current weekly availability. 

- Imagine you take over an established YouTube channel with 2,600+ existing videos. What would you do during your first two weeks, and why? We are particularly interested in your thinking process. Please be specific rather than giving us a generic YouTube marketing answer.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short test, which will also allow you to experience the type of work involved in this role.

title: AI Video Editor for Ecom Ads (Higgsfield / Kie.ai)
description:
Pay: $1,200 per month

Work: Remote, long term



We are an ecommerce company with multiple online brands. We are looking for one more video editor for our ad team.



The most important thing for us:

You can resolve tasks by yourself.

We pay well, but we are extremely busy. If you can get the job done, we don't need to talk and micromanage you. We offer multiple ways to expand your knowledge, and while working with us, you will gain LOTS of new skills.



!!If you have never made ecommerce ads, this job is not for you.!!



You must be able to do this on your own:

- Make video ads for online stores

- Use Higgsfield and/or Kie.ai every day

- Turn images into video with AI

- Make AI video look real, not fake

- Make vertical videos for TikTok, Reels and

- Make strong hooks. You know why an ad works.

- Make new ads every day. Not one video per week.



Mention if you have ever (Extra good!):

- Worked on non-English language ads

- Worked in a supplement / health / pharmacy brand

- Made a video with >=1M impressions (with a link)

- Worked with Polish language ads



We do NOT want:

- Wedding or travel video editors

- Nice brand films with no ads

- AI video with only text on top

- Editors who need a long brief for every cut



Only advanced editors, please.



Send me:

- Names of the online stores you made ads for. Add links to the ads if you have them.

- Three to five ads you made yourself. AI UGC is best.

- One line: which AI you use for your video generation and an example prompt.



Start your message with the word "higgsfield". This shows me you read this post.



If I like your work, I send you one paid task. I send you the product and the brief. You make a 1 minute demo video. This task is paid.

title: Purchasing Coordinator (Philippines)
description:
Our company is hiring a Purchasing Coordinator to be the daily contact with our overseas textile factory. You'll place and track purchase orders from quote to warehouse delivery, and check that what arrives and what we're billed match what we ordered.



What you'll do

Manage daily communication with our factory on quantities, specs, pricing, and production timelines.

Prepare purchase orders from our demand planner's reorder quantities, verify pricing, MOQs, terms, and full-carton quantities, and send them once approved.

Maintain a single tracker of every open PO and its expected arrival date.

Track shipments from production through ocean freight to our Los Angeles warehouse, and flag delays early.

Match receiving counts and supplier invoices against each PO, and document any discrepancies.



What we're looking for

2 to 4 years in purchasing or supplier coordination for a physical products company.

Direct experience communicating with an overseas factory, ideally in China.

Experience with the full PO process and matching invoices to POs.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP and pivot tables.

High accuracy, and a habit of checking your own work before it goes out.

Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have: textiles, home goods, or apparel experience; familiarity with ocean freight and Incoterms; Mandarin.

Details



100% remote, based in the Philippines.

Full-time, with hours overlapping US Pacific Time.

$700 to $1,200 USD per month, based on experience.



To apply, send your resume

Analyze potential link opportunities based on Domain Authority (DA), traffic metrics, and organic growth.

Build backlinks using ethical, white-hat SEO methods that follow search engine guidelines.

Develop unique, high-quality content (minimum 800 words) for link placement, ensuring content relevance and proper optimization.

Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Moz, or SEMrush to evaluate link opportunities.

Strong understanding of content creation and optimization.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer – CRM, SaaS, API & Automation
description:
FULL-STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER – CRM, SAAS, API & AUTOMATION

⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING ⚠️

We are an established Canadian company looking for an experienced, highly resourceful Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our team remotely from the Philippines.

This is a full-time, long-term position.

We are not looking for someone who only knows basic website development or no-code automation. We need a strong developer who can understand business requirements, build complete applications, troubleshoot complex technical problems, integrate multiple systems, and eventually help us design and develop our own CRM, internal applications, and SaaS products.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our company currently uses multiple systems and platforms, including 
, Zapier, APIs, web-based applications, and other business software.

Many of these systems communicate through APIs, webhooks, automations, and integrations.

We need someone who can understand the entire technology workflow, not just one individual platform.

For example, if information should move from 
 → Zapier → an external API → another system, and something stops working, you should be capable of investigating the entire workflow, identifying where and why the failure occurred, and implementing a reliable solution.

At the same time, we have larger development projects planned.

Our long-term objective is to develop more of our own technology, including potentially a custom CRM, internal management systems, dashboards, customer portals, workflow systems, and SaaS applications.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and develop custom web applications

- Help architect and build our own CRM

- Develop internal business applications and future SaaS products

- Handle both front-end and back-end development

- Design, build, and maintain databases

- Develop dashboards, admin panels, user accounts, roles, and permission systems

- Build and maintain REST APIs

- Integrate third-party APIs and services

- Work with JSON, webhooks, OAuth, authentication, and data synchronization

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Zapier automations

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot 
 workflows, automations, and API integrations

- Diagnose problems involving multiple connected platforms

- Develop custom integrations when Zapier or other no-code tools are not sufficient

- Automate repetitive business processes

- Troubleshoot bugs, failed automations, API errors, and production issues

- Implement proper logging and error handling

- Improve the reliability and performance of existing systems

- Test and document applications and integrations

- Implement appropriate security, user permissions, backups, and access controls

- Research and recommend technical solutions

- Work directly with management to transform business requirements into working software

- Take ownership of technical problems from investigation through resolution

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a problem solver — not simply someone who waits for step-by-step programming instructions.

You should be able to understand a business problem, ask the right questions, determine the technical requirements, recommend a solution, and then build it.

For example, if we tell you:

"We need customers to submit an application online, automatically create a record, verify information through an external API, assign the application to an employee, track its status, trigger notifications, and display everything in a management dashboard."

You should be capable of helping determine how the system should be structured and then developing the solution.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Strong professional experience in full-stack software development is required.

You should have strong experience in several of the following:

- JavaScript / TypeScript

- React, Next.js, Vue.js, or similar front-end frameworks

- Node.js, Python, PHP/Laravel, .NET, Java, or similar back-end technologies

- PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other relational databases

- REST APIs

- Third-party API integrations

- JSON

- Webhooks

- OAuth and API authentication

- Git / version control

- Cloud hosting and deployment

- Application security

- User authentication and permission systems

- Debugging and troubleshooting

- Zapier or similar automation platforms

- 
 integrations/API

- CRM development or customization

You do not need to know every technology listed above.

What matters most is your ability to build reliable software, understand unfamiliar systems, troubleshoot complex problems, research solutions independently, and learn new technologies quickly.

STRONG ADVANTAGES

- Experience building a CRM from scratch

- Experience building or launching a SaaS application

- Experience developing internal business-management software

- Fintech or financial software experience

- Lending or loan-management software experience

- Customer portal development

- Payment API integrations

-
 and SMS integrations

- Document-generation or e-signature integrations

- Complex workflow automation

- 
 API experience

- Advanced Zapier experience

- AI/LLM API integrations

- Cloud infrastructure and deployment

- Security and access-control implementation

THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is:

- Highly resourceful

- Technically strong

- Independent

- A strong problem solver

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and accountable

- Comfortable researching solutions independently

- Able to learn unfamiliar systems quickly

- Able to communicate technical concepts clearly

- Able to understand business operations, not just programming

- Comfortable taking ownership of projects from concept through deployment

When something does not work, we expect you to investigate the problem, determine why it is happening, and find a solution, rather than simply reporting that it does not work.

EMPLOYMENT & AVAILABILITY

- 40 hours per week

- Remote position based in the Philippines

- Long-term opportunity

- You will work directly with our Canadian company

- Some availability during Canadian Eastern Time business hours is required

- The exact schedule can be discussed with the selected candidate

This position requires your full professional attention during your scheduled working hours.

You must not work for another employer or perform freelance/contract work during the hours you are scheduled to work for our company.

If you currently have another full-time job, part-time job, freelance clients, or other ongoing professional commitments, you must disclose them during the application process.

COMPENSATION

CAD $12–$18 per hour (Canadian dollars), depending on experience, technical ability, and level of responsibility.

This is approximately 40 hours per week.

Candidates with exceptional experience building complete CRM/SaaS applications, designing software architecture, and managing complex API integrations may be considered at a higher rate.

Compensation is paid in Canadian dollars (CAD) by our Canadian company.

LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We are not hiring for a temporary project.

Initially, part of your role may involve understanding, maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving our existing systems and integrations.

Over time, we want the right person to take an important role in developing our own technology, including custom CRM systems, internal applications, automation infrastructure, client-facing applications, and potentially SaaS products.

For the right person, there is significant opportunity to grow with the company and take greater technical responsibility.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your resume and answer ALL of the questions below.

Generic applications or applications without complete answers will not be reviewed.

1. How many years of professional software development experience do you have?

2. What programming languages, frameworks, databases, and cloud technologies do you use most frequently?

3. Have you personally built a CRM, SaaS platform, or internal business application from scratch? If yes, describe exactly what you personally designed and developed.

4. Describe an application you developed that included a front end, back end, database, authentication, and APIs. What technologies did you use, and what parts did you personally build?

5. Describe a difficult API or integration problem you personally diagnosed and solved. What was the problem, how did you identify it, and how did you solve it?

6. What experience do you have with 
, Zapier, APIs, webhooks, or similar automation/integration platforms?

7. Technical scenario: Data should move from 
 → Zapier → an external API → our internal system, but some records occasionally fail to synchronize. How would you investigate and troubleshoot this problem?

8. If we asked you to build a custom CRM from scratch, briefly explain how you would approach the project from requirements and architecture through development, database design, testing, security, and production deployment.

9. Please provide links to 2–3 applications or projects you personally developed, if available. For each project, explain exactly what you personally built.

10. Please provide your GitHub and/or portfolio link, if available.

11. Are you currently employed full-time, part-time, or working with freelance clients? Please explain your current professional commitments.

12. Can you commit to working 40 hours per week and provide some availability during Canadian Eastern Time business hours? Yes/No

13. What is your expected hourly rate in Canadian dollars (CAD)?

IMPORTANT: We have a strict selection process. Please be specific about what you personally designed, programmed, integrated, troubleshot, and deployed.

title: Packaging & Graphic Designer
description:
Packaging & Graphic Designer

 

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our team. We are a small but busy company selling worldwide on Amazon, eBay, Walmart and our own Shopify website - and we're now expanding into retail outlets too. We're looking for a talented designer to join our creative team, primarily focused on packaging design as we bring our products to retail shelves.

 

A strong portfolio of retail packaging design is required - we need to see print-ready artwork, not just digital renders.

 

The ideal applicant needs to be highly skilled at Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator, with a solid understanding of print production (dielines, CMYK, bleed, spot colours), and comfortable working with print-ready file formats (e.g. AI, PDF, layered PSD, dieline templates).

 

Previous experience with HTML email campaigns (e.g. Klaviyo) is a hugely advantageous skill, as is video editing and/or 3D rendering experience.

 

You'll thrive in this role if you:

• Are comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Photoshop generative fill, Midjourney) to speed up concepting and mockups

• Work quickly and efficiently, comfortable managing 2-3 packaging projects at once within a 4-hour window

• Have a sharp eye for detail and can accurately reference/match existing brand packaging systems

• Have excellent alignment and layout skills, with a precise, methodical approach to artwork

• Follow brand guidelines precisely across every project



Your duties will include:

• Work closely with our Product Development team to create new packaging designs based on brand guidelines and feedback from the director/team

• Design print-ready, dieline-accurate retail packaging artwork (boxes, cartons, labels)

• Design instruction booklets and product inserts

• Ensure all packaging and print artwork strictly follows brand guidelines

• Ensure packaging designs meet all relevant compliance requirements

• Create Amazon product images and support A+ Content/EBC as required

• Create and edit email campaign imagery (occasional)

• Handle other day-to-day photo/design editing tasks as needed



Highly advantageous skills:

• HTML email campaign experience (e.g. Klaviyo)

• Video editing experience (Adobe After Effects and/or Premiere)

• 3D render experience (for packaging mockups/previews)



We're ideally looking for someone who is already fully trained and comfortable across these skills, though we can provide further training in specific areas if needed.

 

Please note: this is a part-time role, so we understand you may take on other work. However, the hours you commit to us must be fully dedicated to us - please don't schedule other jobs, clients, or tasks during your working hours with us.



Hours: 10am - 2pm (UK time)

 

Please make sure to supply links to your portfolio - packaging/print design examples are especially important for this role.

 

Only applications with a portfolio will be considered.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Real Estate Team
description:
Position Title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Location: REMOTE

Employment Type: Full-Time



About AlphaX RE Capital

AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliated entities form a women-founded, integrated real estate firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Committed to creating innovative and sustainable housing solutions throughout California, our group manages an extensive and growing portfolio of assets and development projects. We are a leader in addressing the housing crisis by developing sustainable and affordable communities.

Taking a comprehensive approach, we oversee the complete real estate lifecycle from end to end. AlphaX emphasizes diversity, equity, and social impact, with initiatives such as the AlphaX Foundation and Small Builders Association empowering future leaders, women, and minorities in real estate. Our headquarters is located in Cupertino, CA, with additional offices in Southern California and Arizona.



About the Role:

We are looking for a proactive and motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our growing real estate team. The SDR will play a key role in generating new business opportunities by engaging potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting qualified appointments for our agent team. This position is ideal for someone who is organized, persuasive, and thrives in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities:

- Prospect and qualify leads through phone calls, text, email, and CRM outreach.

- Respond promptly to inbound inquiries from online platforms, social media, or marketing campaigns.

- Conduct initial needs assessments to understand buyers’ or sellers’ timelines, goals, and motivation.

- Schedule listing or buyer consultation appointments for senior agents.

- Maintain accurate records of leads and activity in the team CRM (e.g., Salesforce).

- Collaborate closely with the marketing and operations teams to optimize lead conversion.

- Track daily activity metrics — calls, texts, emails, appointments set, and conversion rates.

- Follow up with past clients, warm leads, and sphere contacts to generate repeat and referral business.

- Continuously learn about new construction communities, local market trends, and loan products to better engage prospects.



What We’re Looking For

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills — comfortable engaging with potential clients over the phone and online.

- Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple lead sources simultaneously.

- Prior experience in real estate sales, inside sales, customer service, or telemarketing preferred.

- Familiarity with real estate CRM systems and marketing automation tools is a plus.

- Goal-oriented with a strong sense of accountability and urgency.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

- Qualified appointments set per week/month.

- Lead-to-appointment conversion rate.

- Response time to inbound leads.

- Follow-up consistency and pipeline activity.

- Contribution to overall team closings.



Why Join AlphaX?

- Shape Our Strategic Growth: AlphaX is in a pivotal phase of expansion. This is a defining opportunity to partner with our leadership to scale the organization, influence our corporate trajectory, and build a lasting industry legacy.

- Accelerated Professional Advancement: Our entrepreneurial, high-performance environment rewards driven professionals with substantial career progression and unparalleled exposure to the complete real estate lifecycle.

- Mission-Driven Execution: Collaborate with a deeply passionate, high-caliber team dedicated to executing complex, innovative strategies that actively solve California’s housing challenges.

- Forward-Thinking Strategy: Operate in a highly dynamic environment. Backed by an expanding portfolio of assets, we move decisively to capitalize on market opportunities and encourage innovative solutions to traditional real estate challenges.



Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is $600 to $750 per month. The actual salary offer will be determined based on the successful candidate's geographic location, relevant experience, and specific skill sets, in accordance with California laws.



AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliates are Equal Opportunity Employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees in accordance with the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA). All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications

title: Claude AI Operator for a Shopify Fashion Brand | Build Our Support, Supplier & Reporting Automations
description:
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We run a sub niche fashion brand on Shopify, selling across the Big Five markets, with fulfillment through an agent in China. We are looking for one person who runs our support inbox, keeps our supplier sharp, and builds the AI systems behind both: agents that prepare replies, dashboards and reporting that fill themselves from what comes in, and automations that catch problems before a customer does.



This is a building role with a support inbox attached, not the other way around. We work in Claude. If you have not set up agents, workflows or reporting in Claude yourself, this is not the role for you, however good you are at support.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



These are the first projects. You will own them.



- An agent that reads incoming customer
s and prepares the reply, so all a human does is check and send

- Dashboards and reporting that build themselves from the inbox: refund reasons, sizing issues, recurring product problems, supplier performance

- A supply check that flags orders sitting still too long and raises it with the agent before the customer writes in

- A product quality guarantee: checks that trigger after a set number of orders to confirm what the supplier ships still meets - our standard, and a clear process when it does not

- A dispute agent that kicks in when a chargeback comes in and gathers the evidence

- Stock alerts so we reach the agent before a product runs out



WHAT YOU WILL RUN



- The support inbox: order questions, tracking, delays, refunds, replacements, sizing, complaints

- Direct communication with our agent in China about orders, stock, quality, replacements and delays, followed through until it is actually solved

- Chargebacks and payment disputes, from gathering evidence to submitting the case

- Reviewing AI drafted replies and catching what the AI gets wrong before it reaches a customer



We provide the Claude account and workspace.



HARD REQUIREMENTS



Both are required. Please do not apply if you are missing one.



1. Hands-on Shopify dropshipping support with direct communication with Chinese suppliers or fulfillment agents. You know what long transit times, tracking that goes quiet and stock that runs out look like from the inside.

2. Advanced, hands-on experience with Claude. You have built agents, workflows, prompt systems or self-filling reports in Claude that you or others actually use. Experience with other AI tools is a plus, not a substitute. Using AI to polish
s does not count.



The only exception to point 2: if you have built something with another AI tool that is so strong we need to know about it, tell us exactly what it does and show it. Otherwise, without real Claude experience, we will not move forward.



STRONG PLUS



Advanced operations experience: 

1. you have owned quality control, supplier performance or refund reduction, not only the inbox

2. Fashion or apparel experience, especially sizing and returns

3. Chargeback and dispute handling



Also required: previous ecommerce support experience, strong written English, comfortable building in Google Sheets, Excel or Notion, and able to work independently from an SOP while thinking for yourself.



COMPENSATION



The base rate is $4 USD per hour, starting at 1 to 2 hours per day. That is the starting point, not the ceiling. Rate and hours grow as the automations you build start saving real time, and we agree the milestones for that together in your first week.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer these in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. No need to name previous stores or suppliers, we respect that.



1. Your Shopify dropshipping experience: what kind of products, what your day to day looked like, and how the communication with the Chinese supplier or agent worked.

2. What you have done with AI so far, and with Claude specifically. Which agents, workflows or reports you built, what they do, and who uses them.

3. How you make sure AI makes as few mistakes as possible. What you check, what you never let it d
 alone, and how you catch it when it goes wrong.

4. Your operations experience beyond the inbox: quality checks, supplier performance, refund reduction or similar, and what came out of it.

5. Whether you have experience with chargebacks and disputes, and if so, what your role was.

6. A screenshot or link of a report, dashboard or workflow you built. Client data removed is fine.

7. Your weekly availability.



Applications that are clearly one unedited AI answer, or that skip the questions, will not be considered.

title: E-commerce Video Editor – Short-Form Facebook & Instagram Ads
description:
We’re hiring two full-time video editors to create and localise short-form ads for our e-commerce brands on
 and Instagram.



Most assignments start with an existing video. Your job will be to adapt it for our brands and different markets, updating the voiceover, captions, branding and offers while keeping the ad engaging and natural. You’ll also occasionally create new ads using existing product footage and supplied scripts.



We’re looking for someone who understands how to grab attention in the opening seconds, keep viewers watching and communicate product benefits clearly.



This is a long-term, fully remote role. You’ll work with our editor manager, who provides briefs, answers questions and gives feedback.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Localising existing video ads for different markets and languages using our workflow and tools.

- Creating strong opening hooks that give viewers a reason to keep watching.

- Keeping pacing tight by removing unnecessary pauses and choosing relevant clips.

- Producing natural-sounding voiceovers and adjusting cuts and visuals to match.

- Adding accurate, well-timed captions that are readable on mobile and stay clear of app controls.

- Making product benefits, offers and calls to action clear.

- Checking finished videos for caption errors, incorrect details and leftover original text or branding.

- Applying feedback, completing revisions and occasionally creating simple image ads.



The usual target is around 10 completed video ads per working day, primarily adaptations of existing videos. Some assignments also include three simple image ads. We provide all software required to make the videos.



Additional language skills aren’t required. We provide tools and guidance for localisation, but careful checking is essential. Captions must match the final script accurately.



You should have:



- Experience editing short-form e-commerce or direct-response ads.

- A portfolio showing strong hooks, engaging pacing and clear product messaging.

- Confidence using your preferred editing software and working with translation and voiceover tools.

- Strong attention to detail and good written English.

- The ability to meet deadlines, communicate clearly and apply feedback to future work.



Weekend availability is preferred. Additional weekend hours are available as paid overtime, with extra pay on top of your regular salary.



We value editors who take pride in their work, deliver consistently and flag questions or problems early. We offer regular work, clear guidance and opportunities for performance bonuses based on strong work and results.



To apply, please include:



1. A short introduction about your relevant experience.

2. Links to three ads you’ve edited, explaining which parts you handled. (Send your whole portfolio if available)

3. Your availability everyday (how many hours you can work), including whether you’re available for weekend overtime, and your earliest start date.

4. Your expected monthly salary or hourly rate.



Please use “E-commerce Video Editor” as your application subject.

title: Full-Time Remote Editor
description:
Skilled CapCut / TikTok Editor (Clone + Green Screen Content) — PH Time Zone



Looking for a skilled short-form editor to produce TikTok videos for a high-performing page. This is not basic talking-head trimming. A large share of the work is multi-clone videos and green-screen edits that need precise compositing, timing, and audio.



You can use CapCut or another editor you are fast and accurate in.



What the work actually involves

Many videos require real editing skill and close attention to detail, including:

- Clone videos: background removal, placing multiple clones on one background, even spacing, and natural conversation timing so clones do not talk over each other or leave awkward gaps

- Green-screen videos: clean keying, background removal, and accurate image/asset placement

- Selecting the strongest take for each line or clone

- Audio overlays so cuts between clips have no pops, hard cuts, or dead air

- Dynamic zooms, crops, and on-screen text (including sizing/callout text as in the reference videos)

- Clean talking-head assembly when a video is simpler



Please review a few examples of my content so you know the style before applying:



1. Talking head with overlays — tight cuts plus images placed on screen to support what is being said.


 



2. Clone video — multiple versions of the same person on one background. Needs clean background removal, even clone placement/spacing, and dialogue timed like a real conversation (no talking over each other, no awkward pauses).


  



3. Green screen video — clean keying, background removal, and accurate image/background placement so the subject sits naturally in the scene.


 



You will work directly with me on a page that already gets strong reach. On-time delivery and videos that perform can earn bonuses, with room to grow hours and pay.



Requirements

- Proven skill with short-form editing (portfolio or sample required)

- Clean background removal / keying and multi-layer clone placement

- Strong English (you will judge takes and conversation flow)

- Stable, fast internet

- Experience with CapCut and/or TikTok

- Comfortable taking notes and revising quickly

- Available **6–8 hours per day, 6 days per week** (PH or similar time zone)

- Paid via Wise



Pay

$1,000 USD per month for 6–8 hours/day, 6 days/week, plus bonuses for meeting deadlines and strong video performance. Strong long-term fit can move toward higher pay.



To apply

Complete the paid-style test below so I can see your actual skill.



Reference video: 
 

Video Task:


 



Full steps:

- Open the Drive folder and download the Video Task.

- Import the footage into your editor. The audio effect you need is in that same folder.

- Opening section (three-clone sequence):

- Remove the background from the raw takes.

- Choose the best take of each clone.

- Place all three clones on the provided background that can be found in the beginning of the Video Task. 

- Scale and space them so all three fit fully in frame with even gaps, no cut-off heads or feet, and the same ground line as the reference. Do not guess a formula — match the reference.

- Right at the start, place a different country flag on each clone for a short beat, matching the reference for size, position, and timing.

- Time the dialogue so it plays as one natural conversation — no overlapping speech and no awkward pauses.

- Use the audio effect from the folder to censor the word in this section, timed like the reference.

- Add zoom in / zoom out as shown in the reference video.



Remainder of the video:

- Pick the best takes.

- Add zoom in / zoom out where it helps.

- Add text on clips related to sizing, matching the reference.

- Across the whole video, use audio overlays so every transition is seamless — no pops, cuts, or dead air.

- Send me a GOOGLE DRIVE link to your finished recut.



If the test looks like the reference and the conversation between clones feels natural, we can start quickly.

title: CLAUDE AI MARKETING SPECIALIST FOR E-COMMERCE

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Manager (Hands On): Phone, Email, Gorgias
description:
About us

We are a UK premium home fragrance brand (waterless diffusers and fragrance oils) doing over £1M a year, run by the 2 founders. Customers buy from us because it feels personal, so every reply you send should sound like it came from us.



Read this first: this role is hands on



You are the customer service department. You answer the calls,
s, chats and messages yourself, and you own every case from the first message until it is closed. You do not pass cases to someone else to finish.



Once you have the day to day under control, you build the system: the rules, saved replies, help articles, video guides, reports and a written playbook. Then when we hire the next person, they can take over the daily work from you and you step up to run the team.



How we work



We are direct. Feedback is short and to the point, standards are high and things move fast. If you need things softened, this is not the role for you. If you like knowing exactly where you stand, you will fit in well.



What you already have on day 1



Gorgias (live), Shopify, ShipStation, Microsoft Teams phones, a returns log, and setup and troubleshooting videos for every product. You are not starting from nothing.



What you do every day



Answer phone,
, live chat, Instagram,
 and 
 Shop messages in Gorgias

Resolve every case yourself: troubleshoot using our product videos, then send replacements, reships, refunds and returns in Shopify and ShipStation

File and follow every Royal Mail and UPS claim for lost, damaged or stuck parcels until we are paid

Prepare chargeback and PayPal dispute evidence packs

Check social media comments twice a day and handle them using our process

Answer the
 inbox for our second brand, an automotive business 
 only, no phone). You switch between a premium fragrance tone and a more technical, enthusiast tone.

Post a short daily update at the end of every shift



What you build in your first 90 days



Saved replies and rules in Gorgias, including auto assignment so no ticket is ever missed

Help articles for our 10 most common questions

Short setup and troubleshooting video guides for each product, built from the videos we already have, and kept up to date

A tag set and a weekly report: tickets per 100 orders, top contact reasons, our mistakes, carrier claims won in £, and product faults by product. We want the numbers explained, not just listed.

A returns portal connected to Shopify and Gorgias

A monthly product fault report we can take to our suppliers

A written playbook so the next hire can take over from you



How you will be measured



0 unassigned tickets at the end of every shift

Live chat answered within 10 minutes,
s within 24 hours

Every eligible carrier claim filed

Daily update and weekly report sent without being chased



Hours



Monday to Friday: 8am to 5:30pm UK time, with lunch 1pm to 1:30pm

Saturday and Sunday: 2.5 hours each morning, UK time, to keep the queue clear



Please check what this is in your own time zone before you apply. We need these hours every week.



Who we want



Experienced in ecommerce customer service, and you have personally built rules and saved replies in a helpdesk like Gorgias, Zendesk or Reamaze as an admin, not just used one someone else set up

You can do the work now and lead people later. A builder and a leader.

Clear spoken English that UK customers find easy to understand on the phone

You make decisions yourself within our rules instead of asking every time

You can look at numbers and say what they mean

You write your own replies. We use AI tools, but customers never get AI written replies.



Your first 30 days

You get a written plan with weekly goals from day 1, and we review it together at day 30.



Where this role goes

Once the systems are built and volume grows past 1 person, you recruit and train the next hire, hand them the daily tickets, and run the function: service levels, response times, returns and refunds, and the help content. Pay grows with the role.



How to apply (read this or you are auto rejected)

Start your reply with the word BEACON.

Record a 30 to 60 second voice sample: introduce yourself, then read this line as if answering a call: "Hi, thanks for calling Magnifiscent, how can I help you today?" Paste the link.



In 5 sentences or fewer: a customer posts publicly on our
 ad, "Don't bother ordering, customer service was non existent." What do you do, in order?



Tell us about a helpdesk you set up yourself. What did you build, and what improved because of it?



Confirm you can work the hours above every week, and state your monthly salary expectation.



Shortlisted candidates do a paid practical test before we make an offer.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.



Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.



Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!



Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:



How you communicate and connect with people.

How you present yourself professionally.

Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.



Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!



Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.



Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.



Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.



Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.



Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

- Maintain a strong focus on both conversion and long-term client satisfaction.



Follow-Up & Client Onboarding

- Follow up consistently with prospects who need additional information or time before making a decision.

- Track pending leads, callbacks, documents, and onboarding requirements.

- Ensure prospective clients receive timely responses and that no qualified opportunity falls through the cracks.

- Coordinate with internal team members to ensure a smooth transition from intake to onboarding.



CRM & Documentation

- Accurately document calls, prospect information, qualification details, follow-ups, and outcomes in the CRM.

- Maintain complete and accurate intake records.

- Keep lead statuses and follow-up schedules current.

- Handle client and prospect information with strict confidentiality and professionalism.



What We're Looking For

- Sales Experience: Proven experience in phone sales, consultative selling, intake, appointment setting, lead qualification, or another high-volume sales environment.

- Communication & Persuasion: Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to build rapport, ask effective questions, handle objections, and confidently guide conversations toward a decision.

- Active Listening: Ability to understand what prospective clients are saying, identify their underlying needs, and respond appropriately.

- Detail Orientation: Exceptional accuracy when recording client information, capturing important details, and managing onboarding documentation.

- Confidentiality & Discretion: Ability to handle sensitive personal, financial, or legal information with integrity and professionalism.

- Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM systems, phone platforms, scheduling tools, and modern communication technology.

- Self-Management: Strong organization and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize high-intent leads and manage multiple follow-ups independently.

- Remote Work: Able to remain productive, accountable, and focused while working independently in a remote environment.

- Language Proficiency: Native-standard English fluency, both written and spoken.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means qualified prospects receive an excellent first impression, receive timely follow-up, understand their options, and move smoothly through the intake process.

You’ll be expected to balance sales performance with client experience—building trust, maintaining accurate records, following up consistently, and helping turn qualified opportunities into long-term clients.



How to Apply

If you are a confident communicator who thrives on connecting with people, qualifying opportunities, overcoming objections, and turning conversations into results, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume in English highlighting your sales, intake, client service, or lead qualification experience.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) U.S. Executive Career Services | Full-Time Remote Contractor | Philippines
description:
About Executive Career Partners



Executive Career Partners (ECP) is an established U.S.-based executive career services company with 40 years of experience helping accomplished professionals and senior leaders advance their careers and navigate career transitions.

As our sales and marketing organization grows, we're looking for a talented Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in the Philippines to engage prospective clients and schedule qualified consultations with our Advisors.

This is not an entry-level virtual assistant or administrative role, nor is it a hard-closing sales position. It is a client-facing prospect engagement role requiring excellent communication, professionalism, organization, and follow-through.



The Role

Your primary responsibility is to engage, qualify, and book prospective clients for consultations with ECP Advisors.

Most prospects have already expressed interest in ECP through our marketing. You'll connect with them through a combination of phone,
, and text/SMS, conduct surface-level qualification, and schedule appropriate prospects with our Advisors.

You'll also confirm appointments, reduce no-shows, reschedule cancellations, follow up with unresponsive leads, and occasionally re-engage older opportunities. As the role grows, outreach may also include social media and direct messaging.

The goal is not to pressure or close prospects. It's to create professional conversations, understand why they reached out, determine whether an Advisor conversation makes sense, and help qualified prospects take the next step.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond quickly and professionally to new inbound leads

• Contact prospects through phone,
, and text/SMS

• Conduct surface-level discovery and qualification

• Book qualified appointments directly onto Advisor calendars

• Consistently follow up with prospects who haven't responded

• Confirm appointments and help maximize show rates

• Reschedule cancellations and no-shows

• Re-engage aged leads and previous opportunities when appropriate

• Maintain accurate prospect records and follow-up activity in Salesforce

• Coordinate with Advisors/Closers regarding scheduled prospects

• Manage scheduling through Google Calendar and related tools

• Assist with CRM organization, lead management, reporting, and related sales support as needed

• Potentially expand into social media/DM outreach and deeper qualification over time



What Success Looks Like

The #1 measure of success is qualified appointments booked for ECP Advisors, along with the quality and show rate of those appointments.

Performance will also be measured by consistent lead follow-up, appointment confirmations and rescheduling, professional prospect communication, accurate CRM management, and strong follow-through.

Specific activity and performance targets will evolve as ECP's sales and marketing organization grows.



What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is confident, professional, persistent, organized, highly coachable, and comfortable communicating with accomplished U.S. professionals and executives.

You don't need to be an experienced U.S.-level salesperson, but this is not an entry-level appointment-setting position. You should have previous client-facing experience and be comfortable initiating conversations and following up until you receive an answer.



Qualifications

• 1+ years of sales, customer service, appointment setting, business development, or other client-facing experience preferred

• Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication

• Confident phone presence and ability to communicate comfortably with Director, VP, and C-suite professionals

• Comfortable with outbound calls,
, and text/SMS follow-up

• Strong listening and interpersonal skills

• Persistent without being pushy or overly sales-oriented

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Comfortable using CRM and scheduling technology

• Salesforce experience preferred; other CRM experience is valuable

• Comfortable with Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, phone/SMS platforms, and similar business tools

• Social media/DM outreach experience helpful but not required

• Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work environment

• Coachable, accountable, and able to learn new processes quickly



Schedule

This is a full-time remote contractor position based in the Philippines.

Typical hours will align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time to allow direct communication with U.S.-based prospects. Some flexibility may be available depending on business needs and circumstances.



Growth Opportunity

ECP has been serving professionals and executives for approximately 40 years, and we're continuing to grow our sales and marketing organization.

For the right person, this role can expand beyond appointment setting. Strong performers may have opportunities to take on deeper prospect qualification, higher-level client conversations, sales and business development, lead management, training, and eventually leadership responsibilities.

We're looking for someone who can succeed in the role we're hiring for today while having the ability and ambition to grow with ECP.
