Create Instagram carousel posts using Canva

Create and edit Reels and short-form vertical videos using CapCut or similar tools

Repurpose blog articles and newsletters into engaging social media content

Turn long-form educational content into simple, visually engaging posts

Create content from customer testimonials, buyer stories, properties, renovation examples, and company materials

Write or refine short English captions

Follow our existing content calendar and posting schedule

Reuse and improve existing Canva templates

Organize image and video assets

Repurpose successful older content

Suggest new carousel and Reel ideas

Maintain consistent branding and professional design quality

Review basic post performance

Turn insights from our Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and marketing team into organic social content



Why This Role Matters



Many of our customers consider purchasing Japanese real estate while living overseas.



Our social media is therefore not just about entertainment or follower growth. It plays an important role in building trust and credibility before a potential customer d
 to contact us or purchase property.



Our content includes:



Real customer experiences and testimonials

How foreigners can buy property in Japan

Remote property purchasing

Property investment and rental information

Renovation and property management

Japanese real estate education

Real properties and case studies

The people and processes behind our company



We want someone who can make these topics clear, professional, trustworthy, and visually engaging.



What We Are Looking For



Strong Canva skills

Strong CapCut or short-form video editing skills

Experience creating Instagram Reels and carousel posts

Good visual design sense

Good written English

Ability to turn long-form content into concise social content

Understanding of hooks, subtitles, B-roll, transitions, and viewer retention

Attention to detail

Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines

Ability to work independently based on an existing content direction



Experience with real estate, investment, finance, travel, relocation, or professional services is highly preferred.



Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT for hooks, scripts, subtitles, and content repurposing is welcome, but you must be able to independently judge and maintain the quality of the final content.



How We Work



Our Content/SEO Specialist handles the strategy, SEO articles, newsletters, topic planning, and content calendar.



Your primary responsibility will be turning that content into excellent visual social media content.



Initially, we expect approximately:



1+ Instagram carousel per week

1+ Reel / short-form video per week



Quality and consistency are more important than simply producing a large number of posts.



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction

Your Canva portfolio

Examples of Instagram carousels you have created

Examples of Reels/TikTok/short-form videos you have edited

Your experience with CapCut or other editing software

Your expected hourly rate

Your available hours per week



Please also answer:



If you were given a 1,500-word blog article about buying property in Japan as a foreigner, how would you turn it into one Instagram carousel and one 15-second Reel?



Briefly explain what information you would select, how you would structure the carousel, what hook you would use for the Reel, and how you would make it visually engaging.

title: Business Development & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**Job Title: International Freight Sales & Business Development Executive**  

**Company: Emerald Global Logistics (EGL)**  

**Location: Remote — Philippines**  

**Schedule: Australian business hours, with agreed flexibility for international customers**  

**Pay: Base salary plus performance commission, depending on experience**



**About EGL**



Emerald Global Logistics is an Australian logistics business arranging international shipments of vehicles, machinery, household goods and containers.



Our established focus includes Australia-to-Ireland and UK shipments, and **we are expanding into international markets worldwide**. We’re looking for a proactive salesperson who can help identify promising markets, win new customers and build profitable shipping routes.



**Your responsibilities**



- Find new customers in Australia and overseas through targeted calls, personalised
s, professional networking and referrals.

- Target importers, exporters, vehicle and machinery dealers, manufacturers, retailers, relocation companies and businesses with regular freight requirements.

- Research potential countries, trade routes and industries, prioritising opportunities based on customer demand and profitability.

- Understand each prospect’s cargo, origin, destination, shipment timing and collection or delivery requirements.

- Work with our Logistics Manager to confirm service availability, supplier costs and operational requirements before making commitments to customers.

- Present approved quotes, follow up consistently and help convert enquiries into paid bookings.

- Build relationships with repeat customers and develop long-term commercial accounts.

- Coordinate with our Sales & Customer Service Coordinator so each opportunity has a clear owner and next action.

- Maintain accurate customer records, quotes and follow-up dates in our shared sales system.

- Report weekly on qualified opportunities, bookings, potential new markets and reasons for lost quotes.

- Follow applicable outreach rules and respect opt-out requests.



**What we’re looking for**



- Proven experience in outbound sales or business development, including helping close sales.

- Freight forwarding, shipping, logistics or transport experience strongly preferred.

- Experience selling internationally or developing new markets is highly valued.

- Clear spoken and written English and confidence speaking with customers from different countries.

- Strong organisation, consistent follow-up and the ability to work independently.

- Experience using a CRM or structured sales tracker.

- Reliable internet, a suitable computer, a headset and a quiet workspace.



**How success will be measured**



We will agree realistic targets during onboarding, focused on:



- Qualified sales opportunities.

- New paying customers.

- Quote-to-booking conversion.

- Gross profit from confirmed bookings.

- Repeat business.

- New international markets that produce profitable shipments.



We value quality and profitable growth, alongside consistent sales activity.

title: Social Media Content Specialist
description:
Virtual Colleague, under Shoutout Digital Group, is looking for a Social Media Content Specialist to support one of our established Australian ecommerce clients.



We’re looking for someone who understands how good social content actually works, not just how to schedule a post or put together a basic Reel.



The main purpose of this role is to take the brand’s creative direction, photography, raw video footage and UGC and turn them into current, engaging social content that showcases the products well, captures attention and helps build interest in the brand.



You’ll work closely with the client’s Creative Lead and an existing Graphic Designer. The Creative Lead will guide the overall creative direction, while the Graphic Designer will handle more polished or design-heavy brand assets.



Your focus will be the social side of the content: d
 how an idea should come to life on Instagram, TikTok and other platforms, editing short-form content, adapting assets into the right formats, publishing them at the right time and helping manage the community once they’re live.



You should be able to look at a piece of raw footage or an existing asset and think about things like: What should the hook be? Is the pacing right? Is there too much text? Does the audio fit? Would this work better as a Reel, Story or carousel? And most importantly, will this make someone stop, watch and become interested in the product?



That social instinct is what matters most to us.



What you'll be doing



- Turn raw footage, photography, UGC and existing assets into Reels, TikToks, Stories and other social-first content

- Edit short-form videos with a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, cuts, captions, typography and audio

- Adapt and repurpose content for different social platforms and formats

- Work with the Creative Lead to make sure content direction translates well to social

- Collaborate with the Graphic Designer when more polished or design-heavy creative is needed

- Keep up with current trends, content styles, platform behaviour and what is performing well

- Manage the day-to-day content calendar and make sure approved content is scheduled and published correctly

- Publish directly within social platforms and check captions, tags, links and formatting before content goes live

- Respond to comments and DMs in the brand’s tone of voice during key engagement periods

- Escalate sensitive, negative or commercially important enquiries when needed

- Support occasional UGC or creator follow-ups where required



What we're looking for



- A strong portfolio of recent social-first work is essential

- Hands-on experience producing or editing Reels, TikToks, Stories and carousels

- A strong eye for hooks, pacing, typography, audio and overall content structure

- An understanding of how content should change depending on the platform and format

- Good judgement around what feels current, engaging and appropriate for an ecommerce brand

- An understanding of how social content can showcase products, build interest and support sales

- Experience managing a content calendar, scheduling and publishing social posts

- Confident written English and comfortable responding to comments and DMs

- Organised, reliable and comfortable working independently with direction from a remote team

- Someone who actively keeps up with social media rather than relying on what worked a few years ago



Again, you do not need to be a full graphic designer. There is already a dedicated Graphic Designer in place, and you’ll work closely with them when more polished or design-heavy assets are required.



We also don’t expect you to own the overall social media strategy. You’ll have direction from the Creative Lead. What we do need is someone with enough social judgement to know how that direction should be executed well on the platform.



We’re open to candidates from fashion, beauty, health, food, hospitality, lifestyle, ecommerce, interiors, homewares or any other visually led category.



The quality of your social work matters much more to us than the industry you’ve worked in or how many years you’ve been doing it. ;)



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote role supporting a client based in Queensland, Australia.



The general working schedule will be:



Monday - Friday

12:00 PM – 8:00 PM AEST (Queensland)

10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine Time



There is some flexibility around the schedule, but you'll need to be available during the client's evening social media window. The brand typically posts around 7:00 PM AEST (5:00 PM PHT), so being online around this time is important for engaging with the community, responding to comments and making sure published content is running smoothly.



Any flexibility around your exact working hours can be discussed during the interview.



Why join us?



At Virtual Colleague, we work with Australian businesses that value long-term relationships, trust and great people.



You'll have clear creative direction and support, while still having plenty of opportunity to use your own skills and social media knowledge. We're looking for someone who enjoys the creative side of social, takes pride in what they publish and wants to grow with a team long-term.



How to Apply



If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to see your work.



Please apply through our application form:







Please make sure your application includes a portfolio or links to your best social media work, particularly Reels, TikToks, carousels and short-form video edits. Your portfolio will be one of the main things we use when shortlisting.



The form should only take around 5 minutes to complete.



Please note that we will only review applications submitted through the application form. Applications or follow-up messages sent through OnlineJobs.ph will not be included in the shortlisting process.



If you're shortlisted, we'll invite you to one friendly interview. That's it. No multiple interview rounds or time-consuming unpaid tests. We like to keep the process simple and respectful of everyone's time ;)



We can't wait to learn more about you!

title: Loan Processor / Transaction Coordinator (Commercial Lending, Remote)
description:
About us

Alpha Capital Funds (ACF) is a vertically integrated real estate firm based in Shelton, Connecticut. Our divisions cover acquisitions, lending, brokerage, property management, construction and investor relations.

Alpha Lending arranges commercial and multifamily loans for real estate investors. Together, Alpha Lending and our brokerage have completed more than $200 million in transactions. We are growing, and we need a sharp, organized coordinator to keep every loan moving from signed term sheet to closing.



About the role

You will own each loan after the borrower signs the term sheet and manage it through closing. Our originators find the deal and negotiate terms; you take over from there as the borrower's day-to-day contact.

You will collect documents, track deadlines, coordinate lenders, appraisers and title, and send clear weekly updates. Our target is to close within 45 days of a signed term sheet, and you will be the person keeping us on that clock.



What you will do:



1. Kick off each loan. Open the
 thread with the borrower once the term sheet is signed and introduce yourself as their closing contact.



2. Collect the good faith deposit. Send deposit requests, confirm receipt with the lender.



3. Manage the lender checklist. Send the checklist to the borrower, set priorities, and book walkthrough calls with our lending team.



4. Coordinate third-party reports. Schedule appraisal and environmental site visits with borrowers and property contacts.



5. Collect and organize documents. Chase rent rolls, operating statements, entity documents and other items, and keep deal files complete and correctly named.



6. Track appraisal review. Monitor report delivery and flag issues to the originator quickly.



7. Clear closing conditions. Work the closing checklist and any added lender requirements.



8. Coordinate closing. Align the lender, title, attorneys and borrower on dates, documents and funding.



9. Keep everyone informed. Send weekly status updates, update our CRM (Salesforce) at each stage, and escalate any deal running more than 3 days behind.



What we are looking for:



Must have

• 2+ years as a transaction coordinator, loan processor or closing coordinator for US clients

• Experience with US real estate transactions (mortgage, commercial lending or title preferred)

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable
ing and calling US borrowers and lenders

• Highly organized: you can run 8 to 15 active files without missing a deadline

• Proactive follow-up: you chase what's missing before anyone has to ask

• Reliable home office: stable internet (25+ Mbps), backup power or internet, quiet workspace, HD webcam and headset



Nice to have

• Commercial or multifamily lending experience

• Salesforce or another CRM

• Familiarity with appraisals, environmental reports, title and closing checklists

• Google Workspace, DocuSign, Zoom



What we offer

• Stable, long-term, full-time role with a growing US real estate company

• Paid training: a documented process guide,
 templates and a 4-week ramp where you shadow live loans before running them yourself

• Quarterly performance bonus

• Direct work with our US lending team and room to grow as we scale



Tools you will use: Salesforce, Google Workspace, DocuSign, Zoom and our shared deal folders.



How to apply

Submit the following:

1. Your resume

2. A 2-minute video or voice recording introducing yourself and describing a transaction you coordinated from start to close

3. Screenshots of an internet speed test and your computer specs

4. Short written task: A borrower is 5 days late sending their rent roll and T-12, and closing is in 3 weeks. Write the follow-up
 you would send them.



Applications without the written task will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview and a short skills test.

title: Senior WordPress & Full-Stack Web Developer (Elementor, Custom PHP/Plugins & Shopify) – Part-Time
description:
About Us:

We are an established digital and web development agency providing custom web development, maintenance, and technical solutions for high-growth businesses. We value clean code, transparent communication, and dependable execution.



We are looking for a sharp, dependable Senior Web Developer with Team Lead Potential. We need someone who can balance day-to-day agency client execution with advanced custom engineering, and who has the desire to grow into our technical lead managing a small team of developers.



Leadership Growth & Progression:



Our goal is for the right person in this role to quickly become the main technical point of contact for our Project Manager and junior developers.



You will review technical requirements, help scope complex tasks, unblock other developers when they have technical questions, and ensure code standards remain high across the entire team.



As you demonstrate consistency and technical judgment, you will step into a Team Lead capacity with increased responsibility and priority hours.



About the Hours & Workload:



This is an ongoing, flexible part-time contractor position.



Hours: Workload depends on your availability and speed. If you prefer a lighter pace, expect 5 to 10 hours per week. If you are proactive, fast, responsive, and want to take on rush tasks and complex tickets, you can secure 10 to 20+ hours per week.



Consistent, reliable developers who communicate clearly and help support the team will always receive priority task allocation.



What You Will Do:

Elementor & WordPress Delivery (Day-to-Day Core): About 90% of our client websites are built in WordPress using Elementor. You will build, update, and troubleshoot responsive pages, custom global templates, forms, dynamic loops, and layout fixes quickly and cleanly.



Custom Code & Plugin Development (Advanced Work): When page builders hit their limit, you step in. You will write clean custom PHP, build custom WordPress themes, develop custom plugins from scratch, and architect Custom Post Types (CPT) with ACF Pro.



Shopify & Multi-CMS Support: Handle Shopify theme edits, Liquid code customizations, Section rendering, and occasional work on Webflow, BigCommerce, or Wix Studio.



Technical Leadership & Escalation: Serve as the go-to technical resource for our team. You will clarify technical requirements, review architecture, and answer questions from junior developers so they don't get stuck.



AI-Accelerated Workflow: We actively encourage using modern AI tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and LLMs) to speed up research, code drafting, refactoring, and troubleshooting. You are fully responsible for understanding, thoroughly testing, and validating all output before deploying.



Self-QA & Clean Handoffs: Thoroughly test your own work on desktop and mobile before passing staging links to our Project Manager and QA team.



Required Qualifications:

Deep Elementor Expertise: Fast, pixel-perfect page building, theme builder proficiency, mobile responsiveness, and clean CSS styling without bloated DOM elements.



True Custom Coding Depth: Demonstrated ability to write custom PHP and JavaScript from scratch. You must have actual experience coding custom WordPress plugins or custom themes from the ground up (not just configuring pre-made themes).



Shopify / Liquid Experience: Comfortable navigating Shopify theme code, Liquid templates, and Sections.

Leadership & Mentorship Mindset: Comfortable breaking down technical requirements, explaining complex concepts to junior team members, and guiding technical best practices.



AI Tooling Literacy: Practical experience using AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to enhance your speed and code quality without sacrificing engineering rigor.



Version Control: Familiarity with Git/GitHub and staging environments.



Clear Communication: Must provide transparent updates to our Project Manager on task status, estimated completion times, and any blockers.



Reliable Workstation: Stable high-speed internet connection with an active power and secondary internet backup system.



Bonus Points (Not Required, but Great to Have):



Experience building Shopify themes, Webflow sites, or BigCommerce stores from scratch.

Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party SaaS integrations.

Prior experience as a Team Lead or Senior Developer managing a small team of engineers.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY TO AVOID DISQUALIFICATION):

We take attention to detail and reliability very seriously. Applications that fail any of the instructions below will be automatically archived without review.



The Exact Subject Line (Filter 1):



Your application subject line must be formatted EXACTLY as follows (replace bracketed text with your info):



"Core Dev Ready - [Your Name] - [Years of WordPress Experience]"



(Any other subject line will be automatically rejected).



The "Secret Word" Check (Filter 2):



Start the very first sentence of your cover letter with the word: "Bluebonnet".



Short Questions to Answer:



How many years have you actively built production websites using Elementor?



What custom WordPress plugins or custom themes have you built completely from scratch? (Briefly explain what they did).



Have you ever guided, mentored, or unblocked junior developers before? What does your process look like when someone on the team is stuck?



What AI tools do you use in your development workflow (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), and how do you ensure the code they generate is safe, clean, and bug-free?



Do you currently have a full-time job, or are you strictly freelancing?



What are your usual daily working hours in Philippine Time (PHT), and what hours can you overlap with US Central Time (CT)?



Are you looking for a steady 5–10 hours/week, or are you hungry to take 10–20+ hours/week and grow into a Lead role?



What is your backup setup if your power or primary internet goes out?



Loom Screenshare Video (Filter 3 - MANDATORY):



Include a link to a quick 2-to-3 minute Loom (or screenshare) recording showing:



An Elementor site you built or styled.



A quick look at your code editor or GitHub repository showing custom PHP/JS code, a custom theme, or a custom plugin you wrote yourself from scratch.



(Please note: Applications with screenshots only will not be considered—we require a brief screen walkthrough).



Portfolio:



Provide 2 to 3 live links to websites you built or contributed to.

description:
FULL-TIME SEO & GEO GROWTH MANAGER



IMPORTANT: READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING.



There is a secret word hidden somewhere inside this job post. If you do not include the secret word in your application, I will not respond to you.



This is intentional. I need someone who pays attention to details, follows instructions, and actually reads before taking action.



We are looking for an extremely driven, experienced, and resourceful SEO & GEO Growth Manager to work with us full-time.



This is NOT a role for someone who only knows how to write blog posts, install an SEO plugin, or run basic keyword research.



I need someone I can genuinely rely on to take ownership of our entire organic presence and aggressively grow both my personal brand and my companies across Google, ChatGPT, AI search engines, podcasts, websites, and the broader internet.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will take ownership of:



* Full SEO strategy for multiple company websites

* Technical SEO audits and implementation

* On-page SEO

* Off-page SEO

* Keyword research and content strategy

* High-quality backlink acquisition

* Competitor backlink analysis

* Digital PR and authority building

* Podcast outreach and getting me booked as a guest

* Finding interview, article, press, and collaboration opportunities

* Building citations and brand mentions across reputable websites

* Google Business Profile optimization and management

* Reputation and review strategy

* Local SEO where applicable

* Website SEO health and optimization

* Monitoring rankings, traffic, indexing, and conversions

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics

* Schema / structured data

* Internal linking

* Content briefs and content optimization

* Link-building outreach

* Identifying and fixing technical SEO problems



You should also understand or be actively experienced in:



GEO — Generative Engine Optimization

AEO — Answer Engine Optimization

AI Search Optimization



I want our brands and my name to become more visible when people search relevant questions inside platforms such as:



* ChatGPT

* Google AI Overviews

* Perplexity

* Claude

* Gemini

* Other AI-powered search engines



You should understand how brand authority, third-party mentions, authoritative backlinks, entity signals, structured data, content, citations, PR, and digital footprint can influence visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search.



(Secret word: HOPE)



THIS ROLE REQUIRES OWNERSHIP



I do not want to constantly tell you what to do.



I want someone who can look at our current presence, identify weaknesses, create a strategy, explain the strategy to me, and then execute it.



If something is wrong with one of our websites, I expect you to find it.



If competitors are outranking us, I expect you to figure out why.



If there are podcast opportunities, backlink opportunities, directories, PR opportunities, or websites we should be featured on, I expect you to find them and pursue them.



You should constantly be thinking:



“How do we make this company and founder impossible to ignore online?”



EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You MUST have a proven track record.



When applying, be prepared to show:



* Websites you have personally worked on

* SEO results

* Ranking improvements

* Traffic growth

* Backlinks you have acquired

* Google Search Console screenshots

* Case studies

* Clients or businesses you have worked with

* Examples of successful outreach

* Examples of podcast placements, PR placements, or authority-building campaigns if applicable



Do NOT apply if you cannot provide proof of your work.



Shortlisted candidates should also be comfortable performing a detailed audit of our current websites, rankings, backlink profile, Google presence, and overall organic visibility as part of the interview process.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You are probably a good fit if you are:



* Extremely proactive

* Detail-oriented

* Competitive

* Analytical

* Reliable

* Organized

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
We are a performance marketing agency based outside Atlanta, Georgia. We run paid search, SEO, paid social, programmatic, and web services for small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S. Our clients trust us to move their numbers, and staying close to their accounts is how we keep that trust.



We are hiring a Client Services Coordinator to help us stay close to every client.



What This Role Is



This is an entry-level, client-facing support role. You will start from the ground up. We will train you on our clients, our process, and our tools. As you grow, you will take on more ownership of the accounts you support.



You will not be running ad campaigns yourself. Your job is to keep our clients organized, informed, and well cared for. You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks and every client feels taken care of.



This is a role for someone who wants to learn and grow with an agency. What matters most to us is not what you already know, but your written and spoken English, your attention to detail, and your willingness to be taught.



What You Will Be Doing



Learn every account. Get to know the status, goals, deliverables, and open items for each client. Over time, you become the person who can speak to any account at a moment's notice.



Join client calls. Attend calls alongside the team, take clear and thorough notes in real time, and track every decision and action item.



Write call summaries and next steps. After each call, send a clean, well-written recap to the client covering what was discussed, what was d
, and what happens next, with clear owners and dates.



Send finalized reports. Deliver monthly performance reports to clients once they have been reviewed and finalized internally, with a short, clear note framing the results.



Assemble client-facing materials. Put together decks, recaps, onboarding documents, and other materials that keep clients informed and confident.



Keep communication tight. Respond to client questions promptly, chase down answers internally, and make sure follow-ups actually get followed up on.



Be the connective tissue. Serve as the organized link between our specialists (search, social, SEO, web) and the client, so everyone stays aligned.



What We Are Looking For



Exceptional written English. Your emails and summaries read as polished, professional, and native-level. Grammar, tone, and clarity are second nature.



Exceptional spoken English. You are clear, confident, and easy to understand on live client calls with U.S. business owners.



Meticulous attention to detail. You catch the small things, keep accurate notes, and never let an action item slip.



Strong organization. You can hold the details of many clients in order at once and always know the current state of each.



Eager to learn. You are coachable, take feedback well, and want to build a career in client services. We will train you. You bring the willingness.



Proactive and reliable. You follow through without being chased and take real ownership of what you are given.



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Experience in digital marketing, an agency, or client services / account management.



Familiarity with paid search, SEO, paid social, or web projects. Enough to follow the conversation, not to execute it.



Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, Slack, project management software, and reporting dashboards.



Details



Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, U.S. Eastern business hours. This means evening and overnight hours in the Philippines.

Type: Independent contractor, entry-level, with full training provided.

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines.

Reports to: Managing Director.

Requirements: Dependable internet connection and a quiet space for calls.



How to Apply



Answer these 3 things. Applications that do not include all 3 will not be reviewed.



A short introduction telling us why this role fits you. This is your first writing sample. We read it closely.

Your resume. Write a sample client email: You just finished a call with a client who runs a dental practice. On the call, you discussed their Google Ads performance from last month (leads were up 15% but cost per lead increased), agreed to test new ad copy next month, and the client asked about adding SEO services. Write the post-call summary email you would send to the client.

description:
PART-TIME OUTBOUND CALLER / QUALIFY PROSPECTS



Upkeep Standard is a family-owned residential cleaning company serving Northwest Chicagoland. We provide dependable biweekly and monthly home cleaning services.



We are hiring a reliable, confident, and coachable outbound caller to contact prospective customers, create interest in our services, qualify opportunities, and complete accurate follow-up.



This is a remote, part-time independent contractor position.



SCHEDULE



Monday - Friday

10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

20 hours per week



Additional hours may become available based on performance, reliability, and business needs.



COMPENSATION



$5 per hour



Plus a $25 bonus for each new recurring biweekly or monthly customer who completes their first cleaning appointment.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Make outbound calls using company-approved lead lists.

* Follow up with warm leads and previous contacts.

* Explain Upkeep Standard’s recurring cleaning services clearly.

* Ask qualification questions and identify interested homeowners.

s with the correct callback number.

* Create complete handoffs for qualified quote opportunities.

* Immediately document and honor all do-not-call requests.

* Remain logged into Microsoft Teams and available while clocked in.

* Participate in coaching, call reviews, assessments, and practice activities.

* Use only company-approved scripts, tools, pricing language, and processes.



The caller does not independently set prices, promise availability, offer discounts, negotiate rates, or guarantee services.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



During a typical four-hour shift, the caller should work toward:



* 60–80 outbound calls

* Consistent follow-up on assigned leads

* Accurate documentation of all activity

* Professional and natural conversations

* Qualified quote opportunities, not unqualified names

* Complete and timely handoffs

* 100% compliance with do-not-call requests

* Reliable attendance and communication



Early performance will be measured primarily by qualified opportunities generated per 100 calls. Closed recurring customers and acquisition cost will be evaluated after the caller has completed the training and ramp-up period.



TRAINING AND RETENTION REQUIREMENTS



Training includes independent study, service and policy review, script practice, objection handling, mock calls, recorded practice, assessments, and supervised production.



To continue beyond training, the caller must:



* Complete all assigned training activities.

* Use the approved script naturally rather than reading mechanically.

* Correctly handle common objections and do-not-call requests.

* Enter complete notes and follow-up information.

* Demonstrate consistent attendance, communication, and coachability.

* Generate qualified interest during supervised calling.



Bringing in a new customer during training is encouraged but is not required to pass. Continued employment will be based on the behaviors and results the caller can control.



PROBATION AND REVIEWS



The position begins with a three-week probationary period.



Performance will be reviewed through weekly checkpoints, with a broader evaluation after six weeks. The evaluation will consider:



* Attendance and punctuality

* Call activity

* Conversation quality

* Qualified opportunities

* Follow-up completion

* CRM documentation

* Call-recording quality

* Coachability

* Policy compliance

* Recurring customers generated



Meeting the minimum standards does not guarantee additional hours. Strong and consistent performance may lead to expanded responsibilities and more hours. A longer-term performance review will also be completed after three months.



QUALIFICATIONS

* Strong listening and communication skills

* Ability to sound conversational rather than scripted

* Comfortable making repeated outbound calls

title: Guest Services Specialist (Property Management)
description:
Key Responsibilities:



Step One: Listen & Clarify



Read the full conversation and reservation history before responding. Every message should reflect what the guest has already told us. Never make a guest repeat themselves.

Listen for the real issue on live calls, not just the first thing mentioned. Guests under stress don't always lead with what's actually wrong.

Acknowledge the guest clearly and set expectations for what happens next, even when the resolution takes a few more steps.

Correct triage urgency: Tell a true emergency (risk to guest safety or the property) apart from an urgent-but-routine issue and from something that can be logged for the morning and handle each per the client's specific policy.

Step Two: Act & Resolve



Resolve booking questions, complaints, maintenance issues, and general inquiries in real time, following each client's specific policies and procedures.

Make outbound calls to guests, property managers, and vendors to follow up on open issues and confirm resolutions. Don't wait for the guest to have to chase us.

Assist with booking, confirming, and modifying reservations over the phone, including reservation sales support.

Escalate true emergencies and guest-safety issues immediately, following the client's established protocol. No delay, no exceptions.

Coordinate with property managers and internal operations teams during/immediately following live calls to resolve complex situations.

Own every message you send. AI-assisted drafts are a starting point, not a final answer. Review them for accuracy and context before they reach a guest.

Log accurate call notes and dispositions in real time while maintaining full attention on the guest.

Rinse and Repeat



Flag recurring guest issues and process gaps to the team. Every pattern you catch helps us fix something before it hits the next guest.

Attend brief daily huddles and weekly team check-ins.

Qualifications and Requirements: 



Composed and Empathetic Under Pressure: Able to stay calm, empathetic, and solution-oriented on difficult or high-pressure calls. This matters more than almost anything else in this role.

Strong Sense of Responsibility: Demonstrates accountability, reliability, ownership, and follow-through on guest concerns from start to finish.

Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, professional and effective with guests, teammates, and partners.

Accurate and Fast Note-Taker: Able to log call details in real time without losing focus on the guest.

Guesty & Breezeway Proficient: Experience using Guesty and Breezeway (BW) for reservation management, guest communication, task coordination, and property operations. Additional PMS experience is a plus.

Short-Term Rental Experience: Previous experience in short-term rental, vacation rental, hospitality, or guest services is highly preferred.

OTA Background: Required to support a smoother onboarding process. Experience within the last 6 months is preferred; experience older than 2 years will not be considered.

Tech-Savvy: Able to learn new software quickly and navigate multiple systems efficiently. You'll be using PMS and communication tools from day one.

Schedule Flexibility: Willing to work varying schedules based on business needs, including weekends, holidays, and overtime when required.

Location: Must be located within Metro Manila or Cebu, Philippines

Workspace: Stable internet connection and a quiet, dedicated workspace suitable for live calls 24/7.

title: Graphic Designer (Social Media)
description:
We’re a London-based creative and social studio working mainly with premium, editorial fashion, beauty, wellness and lifestyle brands.



We’re looking for a Graphic Designer to support the day-to-day design work across multiple client accounts.



This role is focused on creating considered digital assets from established brand identities, creative direction and visual systems. You’ll be working across social content, campaign assets, presentations and other digital touchpoints depending on the project.



We care much more about taste, consistency and attention to detail than overly complicated design.



Clean layouts, considered typography, consistent spacing and a strong understanding of the wider visual world are EXTREMELY important to us. You should be able to look at a brand and understand not only which fonts and colours it uses, but why certain imagery, layouts, crops, textures and compositions belong within that world.





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

* Design social media assets including carousels, static posts, Stories and Reel covers

* Create digital campaign and launch assets

* Work from existing brand guidelines, moodboards and creative direction

* Maintain strong visual consistency across different formats

* Adapt established visual identities into new layouts without making everything feel repetitive

* Work with typography, hierarchy and spacing to create clean, refined layouts

* Build and maintain cohesive social media feeds so each brand feels visually consistent and considered

* Create moodboards and visual direction for brands, campaigns and content shoots

* Support the art direction of shoots, including references, styling direction, composition, framing and overall visual feel

* Translate a brand’s wider visual world into practical shoot direction and social content

* Create presentation and deck assets where needed

* Prepare files in the correct dimensions and formats for digital use

* Make design revisions based on feedback from the creative team

* Keep design files, folders and working documents organised across multiple client accounts





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

* 2+ year of experience in graphic design or a similar role

* A strong portfolio, particularly across premium, editorial or lifestyle-led brands

* Excellent understanding of typography, hierarchy, spacing and composition

* Strong attention to detail

* Confidence working with clean, minimal layouts where small design decisions matter

* Ability to understand and maintain an established visual world

* Good image selection and cropping instincts

* Ability to work consistently across multiple assets without losing the identity of the brand

* Comfortable working across several client accounts at once

* Strong Canva skills

* Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign experience is a bonus

* Good written English

* Comfortable receiving detailed visual feedback and making precise revisions





YOU’LL PROBABLY BE A GOOD FIT IF…

- You notice when two margins are slightly different.

- You care about whether something is aligned properly, even if most people wouldn’t consciously notice it.

- You understand that minimal design is often harder than adding more elements.

- You can look at a moodboard and understand the visual language behind it, rather than simply copying individual references.

- You know the difference between something that looks premium and something that is simply minimal.

- You think carefully about image crops, line spacing, type scale, negative space and how each element relates to the rest of the composition.

- And you’re comfortable working within an established visual system while still finding ways to make each piece feel considered.





WORKING SETUP

This is a remote role with a flexible schedule, but we require daily overlap between 10AM-3PM GMT for collaboration, feedback and approvals. You’ll work closely with our small creative team and will usually receive established brand direction, references and content before beginning the design work.





HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

* Your CV

* A short introduction about yourself and your design background

* Your portfolio

* Any examples of work for premium, editorial, fashion, beauty, wellness or lifestyle brands

* Links to social accounts or digital projects you’ve designed for, where relevant

title: Revenue Operations & HubSpot Systems Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing UK investment company with a sales team of approximately 20 people.



We are looking for an exceptional Revenue Operations & HubSpot Systems Manager to take ownership of the systems, processes, automations and data behind our sales operation.



This is NOT a basic HubSpot administrator or data-entry position.



We are looking for someone who thinks in systems.



Our objective is simple:



Make our sales team more productive by removing unnecessary manual work, improving our processes and automating as much of the business as practically possible.



You will become the internal owner of HubSpot and our Revenue Operations infrastructure.



What You Will Own



You will be responsible for:



- HubSpot CRM architecture and administration



- Sales pipelines and lifecycle stages



- Properties, lists, segmentation and data structure



- Workflow creation and maintenance



- Lead assignment and routing



- Sales automation

- Client handover processes



- SOP creation and documentation



- Staff HubSpot training



- Identifying opportunities for further automation



You will work directly with the Managing Director and Sales Management team.



However, we do NOT want someone who needs to be told exactly what workflow to build.



We want to be able to explain a business problem to you, for example:



"Our salespeople aren't following up with leads quickly enough."



And for you to independently investigate the data, identify the problem and propose and implement a solution using HubSpot, automation and improved processes.



Examples of Projects



One week you might redesign our lead-distribution system.



The next you could build a dashboard showing conversion rates by salesperson, lead source and campaign.



You might then automate the handover of a new client between different sales teams.



Another project could involve automatically transcribing sales calls, extracting key client information and adding structured notes to HubSpot.



You could then identify that a particular administrative process is costing every salesperson 30 minutes per day and build an automation that eliminates it.



Your job is to continuously make the company more efficient.



What We're Looking For



You should have strong experience with:



- HubSpot CRM



- HubSpot Sales Hub



- HubSpot Marketing Hub



- HubSpot workflows and automation



- CRM architecture



- Revenue Operations



- Sales Operations



- Reporting and dashboards



- Data analysis



- Lead routing



- Pipeline management



- SOP/process documentation



Experience with APIs, webhooks, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms would be a major advantage.



HubSpot certifications are highly desirable.



Experience supporting a high-volume sales team is particularly valuable.



The Person We're Looking For



You are:



- Extremely organised



- Analytical



- Technically capable



- Commercially minded



- Proactive



- Comfortable challenging inefficient processes



- Excellent at written and spoken English



- Able to work independently



- Obsessed with automation and efficiency



Most importantly, you're a systems thinker.



If you see something being done manually repeatedly, your natural reaction should be:



"Why aren't we automating this?"



Working Arrangement



This is a full-time, remote, long-term position.



You will need significant overlap with normal UK working hours and will work closely with our management and sales teams.



For the right person, there is considerable scope to grow the role and take ownership of the company's wider Revenue Operations infrastructure.



How To Apply



Please include:



- A short introduction about yourself.



- How many years you have worked with HubSpot.



- Which HubSpot Hubs you have administered.



- Your HubSpot certifications.



- An example of a complex HubSpot automation you personally designed and implemented.



- An example of a sales process you improved using automation.



- An example of a dashboard/reporting system you created.

Finally, answer this question:

title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

-Conduct follow-up calls after cases are delivered to ensure the practice is satisfied.

-Handle service issues, coordinate solutions with the care team, and own the follow-up.

-Conduct quarterly lab review calls with dentists using their account data.

-Identify opportunities to expand services such as implants, crowns, bridges, partials, dentures, and night guards.

-Make approximately 35–50 calls per day.

-Document every interaction, next step, and outcome in the CRM.

-Work through priority accounts and complete daily, weekly, and monthly reporting.

-Attend a daily 15-minute team huddle with the team lead.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO:

-No cold calling or lead generation.

-No payment collection.

-No production or laboratory work.

-No ticket-only or
-only support.



This is a phone-based account management role focused on customer retention and relationship building.



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:

-Must currently live in the Philippines.

-Available for the fixed US Eastern night shift.

-Clear, neutral English and confident phone communication.

-Dental office experience OR account management experience with measurable retention/recall results.

-Experience as a dental receptionist, front desk staff, office manager, treatment coordinator, dental assistant, hygienist, or dental VA is highly relevant.

-Comfortable speaking directly with US and Canadian dentists and dental teams.

-Able to discuss measurable results such as accounts managed, patients handled, recall/reactivation rates, or retention numbers.

-Strong CRM and documentation habits.

-Experience with platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or Curve is a plus.

-Full-time and exclusive: no other employment, freelance clients, or side gigs.

-Reliable fiber internet with a backup connection and backup power.

-Quiet, private workspace and USB headset.

-Coachable and comfortable receiving regular call feedback.



STRONG ADVANTAGES:

-Previous experience working remotely for a US or Canadian dental practice.

-Strong knowledge of dental terminology such as crown, margin, occlusion, shade, prep, remake, implant abutment, partial, and night guard.

-Previous responsibility for retention, recall, or reactivation metrics.

-Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack, 
, or Loom.



THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

-You prefer
/ticket-based support instead of phone calls.

-You are uncomfortable making 35–50 calls per day.

-You dislike documenting calls and activities in a CRM.

-You are looking for a role with no performance expectations.

-You currently have another job, freelance clients, or side gigs.

-You cannot commit to the fixed US Eastern schedule.



COMPENSATION:

$1,200–$2,000 USD/month fixed salary, depending on dental and account-management experience.



There is no commission plan. Performance is measured primarily by the percentage of your assigned practices that continue sending paid cases each month.



HOW TO APPLY:



Application Link: 
  



Applications submitted outside the provided link will not be considered. Please read and follow the instructions carefully.



The application takes approximately 15 minutes and includes a mandatory 8-question video recording. This recording replaces the first interview.



We want to hear your actual phone voice and see how you approach a customer conversation, not just read a resume.



Strong applicants will be invited to a 15-minute video call with the co-founder within 48 hours.



If both sides are a good fit, you can start immediately. Training begins on your first day.

title: Acquisition Training & Performance Coach
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
/apply-job-1



About us:



With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” Rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:



The Acquisition Training & Performance Coach is responsible for providing dedicated training, coaching, and performance support to the Acquisition Department. This role focuses on developing role-specific knowledge, skills, processes, and behaviors required for successful performance across Acquisition functions. The role is responsible for delivering Acquisition-specific training, facilitating onboarding and refresher sessions, identifying capability gaps, and providing ongoing coaching to improve contractor performance, quality, productivity, and adherence to established processes and standards.



What You’ll Do:



Training Program Design & Development:

• Design and develop engaging training programs, modules, and materials aligned with Acquisition operational goals and requirements.

• Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.

• Customize learning solutions based on Acquisition business needs, role requirements, and competency gaps.

• Develop practical learning activities, assessments, and knowledge checks to reinforce understanding and application.

• Update training materials and resources when Acquisition processes, systems, tools, or SOPs change.

• Identify recurring knowledge gaps and develop appropriate training interventions.



Training Delivery & Facilitation:

• Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for contractors within the Acquisition Department.

• Ensure high-quality delivery and participant engagement.

• Coach and support facilitators/trainers as needed.

• Conduct onboarding, process training, refresher training, and upskilling sessions specific to Acquisition functions.

• Provide additional training or remediation to contractors who require further support.

• Support newly trained contractors during their transition into production.



Performance Coaching:

• Provide individual and group coaching to Acquisition contractors to support continuous performance improvement.

• Review performance results, quality findings, productivity data, and other relevant metrics to identify coaching opportunities.

• Provide timely, constructive, and actionable feedback to contractors.

• Develop coaching or performance improvement plans for contractors who require additional support.

• Monitor progress following coaching interventions and provide follow-up coaching as needed.

• Reinforce correct processes, behaviors, and best practices through continuous coaching.

• Recognize strong performance and encourage continuous development among high-performing contractors.

• Partner with Acquisition Team Leads to support performance improvement while maintaining clear accountability within the operational leadership structure.



Training Needs Analysis & Capability Assessment:

• Conduct training needs assessments within the Acquisition Department.

• Collaborate with Acquisition Team Leads to identify recurring performance issues that may be addressed through training or coaching.

• Analyze performance trends to determine whether gaps are related to knowledge, skills, process understanding, or execution.

• Recommend appropriate training and coaching interventions based on identified needs.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen role readiness, competency, and overall team capability.



Program Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:

• Measure training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.

• Continuously improve programs based on evaluation results.

• Evaluate whether training and coaching interventions result in improvements in quality, productivity, accuracy, and process adherence.

• Identify recurring performance trends and recommend improvements to training content, coaching strategies, or operational processes.

• Work with Acquisition leadership to address recurring knowledge, skill, and performance gaps.

• Recommend improvements to onboarding, training, coaching, and knowledge reinforcement processes.



Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Partner with the Acquisition Operations Team Lead and Acquisition Team Leads to align learning initiatives with Acquisition operational priorities and performance goals.

• Provide recommendations to Acquisition leadership regarding capability gaps and performance development opportunities.

• Collaborate with Acquisition stakeholders to support process changes, new initiatives, and operational improvements requiring training or coaching.

• Support Acquisition initiatives that require training, coaching, or capability development.



Learning Administration & Reporting:

• Track training attendance, completion, and effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate training records and generate reports.

• Track coaching activities, performance improvement interventions, and competency outcomes.

• Prepare reports on training participation, competency results, coaching activities, and performance trends.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Acquisition training materials and documentation.

• Provide management with insights and recommendations based on training and coaching data.



What We’re Looking For:



Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Education, or related field.



Experience: 

• At least 7 years of experience in Learning and Development, Training, Coaching, Operations Training, or a related field.

• Approximately 3–5 years of relevant Sales experience, preferably with BPO or outbound Sales experience. Relevant Sales experience and demonstrated capability are highly preferred given the operational requirements of the role.



Technical Skills:

• Strong knowledge of instructional design models

• Experience in creating learning modules, facilitator guides, and e-learning content

• Proficiency in Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms

• Skilled in Microsoft Office tools, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

• Ability to analyze training metrics, completion rates, and effectiveness reports

• Familiarity with survey and assessment tools for learning evaluation.

• Strong understanding of Sales processes and customer engagement, with the ability to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement. 

• Ability to audit and review customer calls and assess areas such as confidence, engagement, probing, active listening, and adherence to established processes and standards.



Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Strong facilitation and audience engagement capability

• Stakeholder management and business partnering skills

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking ability

• Effective time management and project coordination skills

• Adaptability in handling diverse learners and changing priorities

• Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback through performance coaching.



Industry Knowledge:

• Foundational knowledge of upstream oil and gas operations, production, and well lifecycle.

• Understanding of marketed deal structures and acquisition processes is a plus.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first work environment.

• Demonstrates discipline, focus, and reliability in support tasks.

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.  



What's in it for You:

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $5.85 per hour paid in foreign currency, commensurate with your skills and experience.

• Work your way: Remote Work Set-Up enabling you to operate from the comfort and convenience of your own chosen workspace

• Success Incentives: Enjoy company bonuses and performance-driven rewards.

• Soar with Us: Opportunities for career growth and promotions await you.

• Positive Vibes Only: Experience a supportive and uplifting work culture.

• Annual Bonus: We value your dedication throughout the year, rewarding you with annual performance bonus shared at the end of the year.

• Performance Raise: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. Be ready to seize opportunities for salary increase based on your outstanding performance.

• Performance Incentives: We believe exceptional work deserves recognition. Performance incentives are awarded to individuals who demonstrate outstanding contributions, initiative, and results. It’s our way of celebrating excellence and motivating continued success.

• Discretionary Bonus: At Community Minerals, exceptional work doesn’t go unnoticed. Contractors who consistently go above and beyond may be rewarded with discretionary bonuses, a token of appreciation for outstanding contributions, impactful results, and dedication to excellence. Let your work speak, and the rewards will follow!



Other Requirements

• Willing to work in US Business Hours (CST)

• Must have stable Internet and Power Connection



System Requirements

• To ensure optimal performance and functionality while using different web and application tools, please make sure that your system meets the following requirements:



Operating System:

• Windows: Windows 10 (64-bit) or higher

• macOS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or higher



Processor:

• Intel: 8th Gen Core i3, i5, i7, or newer

• AMD: Ryzen 3 (2018) or newer



Memory (RAM):

• A minimum of 8 GB of RAM is required.



• Recommended: 16 GB RAM for multitasking and optimal performance.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Storytelling, Stock Footage + Light Graphics)
description:
I am looking for a video editor for my YouTube channel. The videos are educational, calm, and personal. I talk to the camera and share advice about moving abroad. Videos are usually 5–15 minutes long.



Please watch 2–3 videos on my channel first: 

This will help you confirm this is the type of work you are well equipped to handle.



This role is a good fit if you:

-Have strong attention to detail.

-Are good at following detailed feedback.

-Are very good at finding stock footage that helps tell the story of the video.

-Can combine my own B-roll (videos and images) with stock footage in a natural way.

-Are skilled with graphics and light animation (text on screen, simple motion graphics).

-Can use editing to build a story, not just cut the video.

-Are self-sufficient. You can make good choices without many instructions.

-Can follow my current style and suggest ways to improve it as the channel grows.

-Communicate clearly and tell me early if there is a question or delay.

-Are available Monday to Friday. I only give feedback on weekdays.

-Meet deadlines.



How this works:

I need 1 video edited per week. For each video, I will send you the footage, my B-roll, and my script with notes for visuals. You edit the full video.



Right now, videos usually take 2–3 rounds of revisions. My goal is to get this down to 1 round per video. I am looking for someone who pays close attention to feedback so we can get there.



Pay:

$50 USD per video, revisions included.

Payment sent through Wise



If we work well together, this can become ongoing weekly work and a long-term role.



How to Apply

Please send a short message that includes:

-Examples of your editing work (portfolio or links)

-One suggestion on how to improve the editing of one of my videos (1–2 sentences is enough)

-Your time zone and availability



Please start your message with the word DETAIL so I know you read the full post. Applications without this word will not be reviewed.
